notes.title: THE FATE OF MIRADOR CHAPTER TWO IS OUT
notes.content: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42632858/387ec3acfcbdbc57f0d41e7067ff91fd772d834a.png[/img] First I wanted to apologize to everyone for the very long wait. As many of you know by now, life is not what it once was just a few years ago. My team members working with me on FOM (story writer in particular) are either deceased or unable to work due to the war. For that reason, I have released whatever I could put together on my own over the many months you have waited in the game for free. I do not know when and if I will be able to resume working on this but the hope is to gain control of the project entirely. Then perhaps figure out a way to move forward with the third chapter. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42632858/cfe732c564181e2dfe9e2ea7309345a00688e327.png[/img]
